title: On Promoting the sale of local wool
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：promote　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 promote 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the engineer ① promoted the sale of local wool in silence, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② promotes the sale of local wool twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ promote the sale of local wool at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ promoted the sale of local wool before — a line in the manual for April 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Promoting the sale of local wool in silence, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ promote the young clerk to a higher post twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Promote the young clerk to a higher post at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ promotes the young clerk to a higher post in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ promoted the sale of local wool again when nobody else would.

⑩ To promote the sale of local wool, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody promotes the sale of local wool twice over again and somebody must promote the sale of local wool in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 促成（一般过去式 promoted the sale of local wool：1978 年工程师头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 促成（一般现在 promotes the sale of local wool：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 促成（不定式 to promote the sale of local wool：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 促成（过去完成时 had promoted the sale of local wool：1972 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 促成（动名词 promoting the sale of local wool 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 提升（promote the young clerk to a higher post：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去提升把那位年轻办事员提了上去）
G. v. 提升（promote the young clerk to a higher post：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 促成（后段两处：新来的工人照例 promotes the young clerk to a higher post，而母亲又一次 promoted the sale of local wool）

answers.why: promote 意为“促成”，1978 年工程师一言不发地促成促成当地羊毛的销路，那是车间里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 promoted。
promote 意为“促成”，自那以后工程师来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 promotes。
promote 意为“促成”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯促成促成当地羊毛的销路”，此处为不定式 to promote the sale of local wool。
promote 意为“促成”，说明书里 四月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人促成过，故用过去完成时 had promoted。
promote 意为“促成”，工程师说“促成促成当地羊毛的销路这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 promoting the sale of local wool 作主语。
promote 意为“提升”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去提升把那位年轻办事员提了上去”，should ever 之后用原形 promote the young clerk to a higher post。
promote 意为“提升”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻提升把那位年轻办事员提了上去（promote the young clerk to a higher post at once），以后再也不要提起。
promote 意为“促成”，新来的工人每个年头都照例提升把那位年轻办事员提了上去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 promotes。
promote 意为“促成”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地促成促成当地羊毛的销路，用一般过去式 promoted 叙述。
promote 意为“促成”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要促成促成当地羊毛的销路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车间记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 promote 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the engineer promoted the sale of local wool in silence, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer promotes the sale of local wool twice over whenever the workshop asks.
Promoting the sale of local wool in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever promote the young clerk to a higher post twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop promotes the young clerk to a higher post in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother promoted the sale of local wool again, and the workshop remembered that half.
